claims_boundary: descriptive only on the frozen 0.15-0.45 m radius support; not confirmatory evidence

energy_sampling_convention.energy_at_recovery_yield: observation[0] before the RECOVERY_YIELD decision's step
energy_sampling_convention.energy_at_return_activation: observation[0] before the RETURN_ACTIVATED decision's step

observed_energy_thresholds.channel_dtype: D-045 float32 widened to Python float

frozen_protocol.proposed_command_role: PASS_THROUGH only when L1 authority is yielded
frozen_protocol.terminal_spin_exhaustion_boundary: the twentieth TERMINAL_SPIN command executes; latch zero-wheel RETURN_HOLD on the next RETURN decision only if contact is absent
